name: star_fig2_geometry
source: STAR Fig. 2 / Fig. 3(a)-(b), p. 396-397; ICRA Fig. 1 (same map); original ui/Environment.createExampleEnvironment() and DetectiveGame.getBasicGame()

geometry.units: applet world units; origin top-left, x right, y DOWN (java.awt screen coordinates)

beam_sides.note: each beam is drawn as two parallel segments 20 units apart, one per side vertex; createBeamDetector call order b1u, b1d, b2l, b2r

geometry.stroke_note: java.awt.BasicStroke(w) defaults to CAP_SQUARE: every wall/beam stroke extends w/2 past both endpoints. The connectivity derived below depends on this (see docs/notes/map-geometry.md).

applet.click_to_world: x = (int)(px * 800f / 400), y = (int)(py * 800f / 400)  (both axes divide by canvasWidth; uniform scale)
applet.hit_test_semantics: Rectangle2D.contains (half-open: x0 <= x < x0+w); first match wins
applet.hit_test_note: beam rect = segment widened +-8 perpendicular, NOT extended along its length; y in [180,185) inside b2l/b2r rects returns room B (rooms tested first)

expected.derivation: raster at 4 cells/unit; obstacles = bounding-box stroke (20), walls (stroke 8, square caps), room rects, occupancy rects, beam side strokes (15, square caps) plus the strip between the two sides of each beam; free space labelled with 4-connectivity; a feature touches a component if a free cell is 4-adjacent to a cell of that feature

butt_caps_on_beams.note: 1-unit leaks at both ends of b1 (215 vs wall edge 214, 290 vs 291) and below b2 (265 vs wall edge 266): R1, R2, R4 merge; butt caps on walls alone change nothing

zero_width_lines.note: 5-unit gaps at the same three beam ends (215 vs 210, 290 vs 295, 265 vs 270)

verified_by: Coordinates copied verbatim from Environment.java@55f57f8; regions/edges recomputed by an independent raster flood fill (not shipped; method in docs/notes/map-geometry.md; cyber_detectives.geometry derives the regions exactly); STAR Fig. 3(a) edge list and Fig. 3(b) region adjacency read off the 500-dpi page renders; STAR Fig. 2 / ICRA Fig. 1 overlaid on the rendered geometry after per-axis rescaling
